articles.title: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026 Special Event: Interactive Learning for Coastal Resilience
articles.description: This session at the Asia-Pacific Ocean Week will showcase innovative learning approaches to tsunami preparedness developed by UNDRR, UNDP, ESCAP and UNESCO-IOC, on the occasion of World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026.

articles.title: Testing coordination before hazards become disasters
articles.description: In July 2026, the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) Regional Office for Africa, co-organized three discussion-based exercises (DBXs) in Angola, Côte d'Ivoire and Zambia.

articles.title: National roadmap for scaling up Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems in Bangladesh (2025–2030)
articles.description: This roadmap presents Bangladesh’s national strategy (2025–2030) to scale up its Multi-Hazard Early Warning System, identifying gaps and outlining actions across four EWS pillars to ensure timely, actionable warnings reach all.

articles.title: São Tomé’s Água Grande District advances local disaster resilience
articles.description: More than 20 representatives convened in São Tomé from 7 to 9 September 2026, for an assessment on Risk-Informed Urban Planning and Making Cities Resilient. The assessment was organised by the District of Água Grande in collaboration with UNDRR.

articles.title: From Awareness to Action: Practical actions for disability-inclusive disaster risk reduction
articles.description: The webinar offers a practical entry point for organizations and stakeholder constituencies seeking to strengthen disability inclusion in their everyday work.

articles.title: Reducing Drought Risk through Prevention, Early Warning and Anticipatory Action
articles.description: Side Event at the 2026 UN Water Conference

articles.title: UNDRR September 2026 newsletter
articles.description: This month's issue covers preparations for International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction 2026, SRSG Kamal Kishore's mission to Cuba, Colombia and Haiti, new data tracking progress under the Sendai Framework and more inside.

articles.title: United Nations renews its commitment to disaster prevention and protection in Haiti
articles.description: The national implementation plan for 2024–2027 covers the four pillars of early warning systems, under the coordination of the Directorate General of Civil Protection. Progress to date includes the first tests of mobile alerts.

articles.title: Women's International Network for Disaster Risk Reduction (WIN DRR) Leadership Awards Ceremony 2026
articles.description: The Women's International Network for Disaster Risk Reduction (WIN DRR) Leadership Awards Ceremony 2026 will celebrate the women leading change in disaster risk reduction across Asia and the Pacific.

articles.title: Locally‑led resilience takes centre‑stage at the 5th International Disaster Resilience Leaders Forum Incheon 2026
articles.description: Under the theme “Translating Locally led Resilience into Action in the Age of Complex Risk and Digital Transformation”, IDRLF2026 addressed persistent implementation gaps for DRR with more than 350 stakeholders.

articles.title: Cuba strengthens links between national and community levels in disaster risk management
articles.description: Civil Defence, meteorological and hydrological services, communications, and urban planning have operated for decades as an integrated system, with clearly defined roles and joint working mechanisms consolidated through practice.

articles.title: Sendai Framework data shows both progress and persistent gaps in reducing disaster risk
articles.description: Officially reported data by national governments through the Sendai Framework Monitor show significant progress in reducing disaster mortality, strengthening disaster risk reduction strategies and expanding multi-hazard early warning systems.
